# Architecture decision records (ADR)

<!-- Generated by skill `init-dsh-project` v1.8 on 2026-10-26.
     Canonical spec: ~/code/claude-template.md Appendix A. -->

An ADR records a decision **already made**: the context, the chosen option, the costs accepted,
and the options that are **now out of bounds**.

| | Issue | ADR |
|---|---|---|
| Nature | A unit of work | Evidence of a settled decision |
| Direction | Forward: not done yet | Backward and permanent |
| Lifecycle | open → closed | accepted → superseded (**never edited, never deleted**) |
| Answers | "Should we do X?" | "We decided X because …, at the cost of …" |

**Write one when** the choice constrains future code and any of: ≥2 valid options were weighed ·
a never / always / default line was drawn · a prior decision was reversed or narrowed · a
trade-off keeps getting re-argued.
**Not for** implementation detail, bugfixes, or freely reversible choices.

## How to write one

1. Copy [`0000-template.md`](0000-template.md) → `NNNN-<english-kebab-slug>.md`, next 4-digit
   number.
2. Fill in: status · date · scope (which code this binds) · decider · context (forces only) ·
   decision ("We decided …", with the hard line written explicitly) · consequences and costs ·
   alternatives (each rejected option and one line why — the ADR's core value).
3. Append a row to the index table below.
4. Accepted ADRs are immutable. To reverse one: write a new ADR, mark the old one
   **Superseded by ADR-XXXX**, and cross-link both ways.
5. In-repo `docs/adr/` is the **only** home for this project's architecture decisions.
   Cross-project decisions go to the vault's `80-Meta/Decision-Log.md`; progress goes to the
   ledger; design-philosophy is the rule, the ADR is the verdict behind it.
